core_issue: Many refractory metals have excellent high-temperature strength but poor oxidation resistance in air at temperatures where they remain mechanically capable.

material_notes.molybdenum: oxidation is a primary design limitation in oxidising atmospheres
material_notes.niobium: requires careful environmental/surface protection at elevated temperature
material_notes.tantalum: excellent corrosion resistance in many chemical environments but oxidation remains a high-temperature consideration
material_notes.rhenium: high-temperature capability is constrained by oxidation and environmental protection

rule: Do not approve a refractory-metal air-service application without explicit oxidation/protection evidence.
